title: Finding your way around CommercePilot
body:
CommercePilot is a fictional ecommerce demo for everyday home and desk essentials. The home page is at /. The collection section is at /#collection. Use the search, category, price, in-stock and sorting controls to explore products. Product details open in a dialog on the storefront; there is no separate product detail page.

The header contains Sign in or the signed-in shopper's name, Bag and the assistant control. Signed-in shoppers also see My orders, which opens the dedicated /orders page. Selecting an order opens its own detail page. Account and Bag open dialogs; they are not separate profile or cart pages. The assistant opens as a panel and is also available on order pages.

There is no address book, Addresses page, saved-address editor, wishlist, gift card system or shopper registration screen. Generic profile/settings pages and an external support portal are not available. The current demo uses pre-created shopper accounts.
